content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies across multiple blockchain networks. For practical digital product sales, the most operationally useful options are USDT on Tron — fastest settlement under 60 seconds, fees under $0.10, widely held in restricted markets — USDT on Ethereum — higher fees but the most widely supported chain globally — Bitcoin — highest global recognition, 10 to 60 minute confirmation depending on network congestion — Solana — fast settlement, fees of fractions of a cent, growing adoption — and BNB on Binance Smart Chain — popular in Southeast Asia and widely available through Binance.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is designed to operate without reliance on third-party services. Once you deploy your payment stack, you gain full control over your digital store and payment processing. This independence is vital for creators seeking to build sustainable revenue streams in regions where traditional payment options are limited. Understanding how these components interact empowers you to optimize your store for efficiency and scalability.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The need for immediate access to funds is a common concern among creators. Using NOWPayments for crypto processing not only provides a faster settlement compared to traditional services like PayPal, but it also eliminates the need for KYC protocols, making it accessible for creators in regions where financial identity verification is challenging. This solution empowers creators to manage their finances independently, enhancing their ability to thrive in a digital marketplace.
Cloudflare Workers automate payment processing, saving you time and effort.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The fee structure of NOWPayments is fundamentally different from conventional platform fees. NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. There is no monthly fee, no setup fee, no payout fee, and no minimum transaction volume requirement. Network fees for the underlying blockchain transaction are paid by the buyer and vary by network — Tron fees are under $0.10, Solana fees are fractions of a cent, Bitcoin fees average $1 to $5 for most transactions. For a $97 product sold through the Sovereign Starter Stack, the total transaction cost is approximately $0.49 to NOWPayments plus network fees typically under $0.10 on Tron. Compare this to Gumroad's 10% fee on the same transaction — $9.70.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

The transaction log in a COREMERCH deployment provides a complete, independently verifiable audit trail of every payment. Each entry includes the transaction hash, which links directly to the public blockchain record. You can verify any transaction independently on Tronscan, Etherscan, Solscan, or the relevant blockchain explorer — no platform intermediary required. If a buyer claims they paid but the transaction does not appear in your order log, you check the blockchain directly. This level of cryptographic verifiability is structurally impossible with conventional payment processors.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments for your digital products, set up a payment processor like NOWPayments that supports cryptocurrency transactions. By integrating a system that utilizes webhooks, you can automate the payment confirmation process, ensuring that customers receive their products instantly upon payment. This method is especially effective in regions with limited access to traditional payment systems.
NOWPayments offers a low 0.5% transaction fee, maximizing your revenue.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those looking to optimize their payment processing further, exploring the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) could be beneficial. This package offers a complete deployment solution, integrating Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments for a streamlined ecommerce experience. Check out further resources at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Set up a self-custody wallet first — Trust Wallet or MetaMask for USDT and other coins, with the private keys stored securely and backed up. Create a NOWPayments account and configure your wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept — start with USDT on Tron and Bitcoin. Set up a P2P exchange account in your country before you need it — Binance P2P, a local exchange, or both. Deploy your stack with NOWPayments configured and the webhook endpoint set. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm USDT arrives in your wallet within the expected confirmation time. Practice a test P2P conversion with a small amount to confirm you know the process end-to-end. When your first real sale arrives, verify it in the database, confirm delivery completed, then convert to local currency through your P2P exchange.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

You can receive crypto payments by integrating NOWPayments with your online store. Configure webhooks in Cloudflare Workers to automate payment confirmations, allowing you to deliver products immediately upon successful payment.
How long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal?

USDT payments on the Tron network typically confirm within seconds, compared to PayPal's processing time, which can take several minutes to hours. This speed enhances your ability to deliver products quickly.
How do creators in Nigeria convert Bitcoin to naira?

Creators can convert Bitcoin to naira using peer-to-peer exchanges like Binance or Patricia. These platforms facilitate easy conversions, allowing for local currency access without relying on traditional banking systems.
What are the fees associated with NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee per transaction, making it a cost-effective option for processing cryptocurrency payments. This low fee structure is advantageous for creators looking to maximize their profits.
Can I use Cloudflare Workers for other payment methods?
Yes, Cloudflare Workers can be configured to handle various payment methods by integrating different payment processors. This flexibility allows you to adapt based on your audience's preferences.
